name: Default
shortDescription: Discord bot that delivers customizable RSS and Atom feed articles to Discord channels, managed from a web control panel.

alerts.message: Login and delivery need a Discord application. Create one in the Discord Developer Portal, set DISCORD_BOT_TOKEN, DISCORD_CLIENT_ID and DISCORD_CLIENT_SECRET in the environment variables, add https://<your domain>/api/v1/discord/callback-v2 as an OAuth2 redirect, then redeploy.
